# apple_background_assets (Data Source)

Lists an app's Apple-hosted asset packs, including archived ones.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_background_assets" "example" {
  app_id = data.apple_app.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the app.

### Read-Only

- `asset_packs` (Attributes List) The asset packs. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--asset_packs))

<a id="nestedatt--asset_packs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `asset_packs`

Read-Only:

- `archived` (Boolean) Whether the asset pack is archived.
- `asset_pack_identifier` (String) Identifier of the asset pack.
- `created_date` (String) When the asset pack was created, in RFC 3339 format.
- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the asset pack.
